verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, export formats, or offboarding and account-deletion path for Qodo. Configuration-as-code via .pr_agent.toml, the self-hosted deployment options, and retrieving findings through MCP or the CLI are adjacent capabilities, but none is documented as a way to export all of a user's data (findings history, rules, governance data) in open formats. No public OpenAPI spec was found either.
